cases.expected: Power click changes title to Btn PWR

cases.expected: Continuously drawn colored circles and text

cases.expected: On-screen charging, mV, percentage and VBus
cases.observed: 屏幕显示充电状态、电池电压 4000 mV、电量 87%、VBUS 5000 mV。动态电源输入未验证。

cases.expected: RTC and NTP UTC plus local time after Wi-Fi and NTP; document placeholders require configured test network

cases.expected: Touch triggers power timer sleep, guest wakes after five seconds
